question: Should Crabbox ship and maintain this Herdr-specific plugin and hidden CLI protocol as an in-repository integration?
rationale: The patch adds a new third-party workflow surface and an enduring internal protocol; code review alone cannot determine whether that ownership belongs in Crabbox core.

options.title: Approve after rebase and proof
options.body: Accept in-repository ownership, then require current-main Kong registration, focused compatibility coverage, and inspectable Herdr runtime proof.

options.title: Keep the integration external
options.body: Decline the Herdr-specific core protocol and maintain the plugin separately using only Crabbox’s public command surface.

recommendation.title: Approve after rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Accept in-repository ownership, then require current-main Kong registration, focused compatibility coverage, and inspectable Herdr runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest visible history across current CLI architecture and the commands wrapped by the proposed integration.
